title: Keith McArthur:
headline: A recap of the personal talk Keith gave the GRIN Therapeutics staff over lunch: a room of drug company people hearing a dad's story.
story: Keith's son Bryson is 20 and wants to be independent like any 20-year-old, but depends on the people around him for almost everything. His diagnosis took almost 10 years.
Keith asked a doctor if Bryson would die from this. Then he found a Facebook group with six other families; his was the seventh. Now there are hundreds. 30 people in that community have died.
He tells the room their work is worth it and can save lives, and ends: you are my heroes.
